title: My Private Info Stays Private
subtitle: Keep your personal details safe online!
objectives: Identify personal information that is not needed for a task.
Explain why it's important to remove unnecessary personal details from requests.
Rewrite a request to keep only essential information for the task.

scenes.title: Welcome, Digital Detectives!
scenes.narration: Hey digital detectives! Online requests often ask for information. Some details might not be needed. Let's learn to keep your private information safe and secure.
scenes.visualAction: A friendly cartoon character winks, then a magnifying glass icon appears over a blurred text document.

scenes.title: What's Private, What's Not?
scenes.narration: An invitation tool needs the imaginary club and invitation details. It does not need your address, password or private photos. Leave those out of this request.
scenes.visualAction: Two thought bubbles appear: one with a house icon and lock, another with a club invitation icon. A red 'X' appears over the house icon.

scenes.title: Spotting Unnecessary Details
scenes.narration: This club invitation asks for club details. But it also asks for your address, password, and photo. These are not needed. Be careful what you share.
scenes.visualAction: A cartoon hand points to a screen showing a 'before' request with highlighted fields for address, password, and photo. A red circle appears around each.

scenes.title: Why Be Careful?
scenes.narration: Sharing too much personal information can be risky. It's like leaving your diary open. Protect your privacy online. Ask a trusted adult if you are unsure.
scenes.visualAction: A shield icon appears, then a cartoon adult figure gently nods next to a child character.

scenes.title: Making it Safe
scenes.narration: Now, let's make that request safe. We will remove the home address, password, and private photo. Keep only the club and invitation details. Your info stays private!
scenes.visualAction: The 'before' request transforms into the 'after' request, with the sensitive fields visibly removed and replaced by blank space or a simple '...'.

scenes.title: Your Turn to Protect!
scenes.narration: You are doing great! Now, be a privacy champion. Remove any unnecessary personal details from the next request. Keep important task details so it makes sense.
scenes.visualAction: A cartoon character hands a clipboard to the viewer. A pencil icon appears, ready to write.

scenes.title: Privacy Power!
scenes.narration: Fantastic job! You learned to protect your information while getting tasks done. Always think before you share. Ask an adult if unsure. Keep practicing these skills!
scenes.visualAction: The character gives a thumbs-up. A 'star' animation plays, then a lock icon appears with a checkmark.

reading.title: What is Personal Information?
reading.text: Personal information is any detail that can identify you, like your home address, password, or private photos. It's important to keep these details private. A tool asking for private information doesn't mean you have to supply it. Always stop and ask a trusted adult if you are unsure about sharing any personal details.

reading.title: Task Details vs. Private Details
reading.text: When you ask a tool to help with a task, like writing an invitation, it needs details about the task itself. For an invitation, this means the club name, tone, and what to include. These are 'task details' and are useful. Your home address or password are 'private details' and are usually not needed for the task.

reading.title: Why Remove Unnecessary Info?
reading.text: Removing unnecessary personal information protects your privacy and keeps you safe online. Sharing only what's needed for the task means less risk. Always use age-appropriate, approved tools and remember that your safety is the most important thing when interacting with any digital tool.

materials.title: Club Invitation Request: Before & After
materials.text:
**Original Request (Needs Improvement):**
"Please write a friendly invitation for a new 'Paper-Games Club'. It should mention fun with origami and board games. Include three lines about joining. My home address is [HOME_ADDRESS], my password is [PASSWORD], and here's my private photo [PRIVATE_PHOTO]."

**Improved Request (Safe & Effective):**
"Please write a friendly invitation for a new 'Paper-Games Club'. It should mention fun with origami and board games. Include three lines about joining."

promptExamples.initial: Write a club invite. My address is 123 Main St.
promptExamples.improved: Write a friendly invitation for a 'Space Explorers Club'. Mention stargazing and rocket building. No personal details needed.
promptExamples.followup: Great! You removed the address. Now, make sure you don't include any other personal information like a password or a private photo.

activity.title: Edit for Safety!
activity.instructions: Read the request below. Your task is to rewrite it, removing any personal information that is not needed for the tool to write the invitation. Keep all the important details about the club and what the invitation should say.
activity.starter: Please write a fun invitation for a 'Mystery Solvers Club'. It should mention solving puzzles and secret codes. Include three lines about how to join. My secret password is [PASSWORD], and here's my private photo [PRIVATE_PHOTO].
activity.expectedEvidence: A rewritten request that removes '[PASSWORD]' and '[PRIVATE_PHOTO]' while keeping all other details about the 'Mystery Solvers Club' and the invitation content.

quiz.question: Which of these is NOT considered personal information that you should be careful about sharing?
options: The name of a fictional club you want an invitation for
quiz.explanation: The name of a fictional club is a task detail needed for the request, not personal information. Home address and private photos are personal details.

quiz.question: A tool helping you write a story asks for your password to a different game. What should you do?
options: Enter the password so it can finish the story.
Stop, keep the password private, and ask a trusted adult.
Send a picture of the password instead of typing it.
quiz.explanation: A game's password is unrelated to writing a story. Do not share it; ask a trusted adult for help if this request appears.

quiz.question: You want a tool to help you write a welcome message for a 'Nature Explorers Club'. Which detail should you definitely REMOVE from your request?
options: Your favorite color for the message's background.
The club's focus on bird watching and plant identification.
Your personal password for a game.
quiz.explanation: Your personal password is private information and is not needed for writing a welcome message. The club's focus is a task detail.

mission.title: Name an imaginary garden club
mission.instructions: Edit this supplied request without filling in any brackets: 'Suggest 3 short, cheerful names for an imaginary garden club that grows flowers. My home address is [HOME_ADDRESS], my password is [PASSWORD], and my private photo is [PRIVATE_PHOTO].' Remove the private details, rewrite the request, and explain your choices.
rubric: I kept the garden-club and flower details.
I kept the request for 3 short, cheerful names.
I removed the address, password and private photo.
I used only invented details and explained my choices.

hints.question: What kind of information is 'personal'?
hints.answer: Personal information is anything that can identify you or is sensitive, like your address, password, or private photos. Think about what only *you* should know.

hints.question: How do I know what details are 'needed' for the task?
hints.answer: Think about the main goal of the request. If you're asking for an invitation, the tool needs to know about the club and what the invitation should say. It doesn't need to know about *you* personally.

hints.question: I'm not sure if something is private or not.
hints.answer: If you're ever unsure, it's always best to remove it! And remember to ask a trusted adult for help. When in doubt, leave it out!

imageBrief.title: Naming a garden club

educatorNotes.sampleAnswer: Activity: retain the imaginary paper-games club, friendly tone and three invitation lines; remove all three private placeholders. Mission: 'Suggest 3 short, cheerful names for an imaginary garden club that grows flowers.' No real personal details are required.
educatorNotes.commonMisconception: Learners might confuse 'task-relevant' invented details (like a fictional club name or activity) with actual personal information. Emphasize that invented details for the *task* are fine, but *their own* real personal details are not.
reviewChecks: I kept the garden-club and flower details.
I kept the request for 3 short, cheerful names.
I removed the address, password and private photo.
I used only invented details and explained my choices.
educatorNotes.safetyNotes: Remind learners that they should never type or share any real personal information, even as part of a learning exercise. All examples provided are fictional. Always encourage children to consult a trusted adult before sharing any information online or with digital tools.
